title: monogramma acrocarpa
intro: Monogramma acrocarpa, commonly known as the Rock Cap Fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Monogramma acrocarpa include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which also contribute to its antioxidant and anticancer properties.
